newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Pioneer launches Russia T-bill fund, sees equities.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer launches Russia T-bill fund, sees equities.

text.p: Pioneer First Investment Group officially launched a domestic unit fund investing in Russian government securities on Wednesday, company officials said.
Pioneer, part of the Pioneer Group, had raised 2.6 billion roubles ($460,000), chiefly from small investors, within three months, thus meeting Russian government requirements, they said.

Timothy Frost, Chairman of the Management Board of Pioneer First Investment Group, said the company would launch a Russian equity market fund concentrating on highly liquid issues, in about a month, barring technical difficulties.
